verdicts.reason: Both candidates are almost identical and broken in the same ways. The reading order is reversed, with "WORLD'S" sitting below "Biggest Plants". The factory photo is shrunk to a tiny thumbnail jammed into the bottom-left corner, and there are large dead gaps above and below the cooling-tower photo. The black top bar is cropped to a sliver and the line-and-dot decorations float without purpose. The only difference is the top decoration: B packs its dots against the short rule so they nearly touch it, while A's dots are scattered loosely, which is marginally less cluttered.
